sloka: स्कंद इति अब्रुवन् देवाः स्कन्नम् गर्भ परिस्रवात् ।कार्तिकेयम् महाबाहुम् काकुत्स्थ ज्वलन उपमम् ॥१-३७-२७॥
transliteration: skaṁda iti abruvan devāḥ skannam garbha parisravāt ।kārtikeyam mahābāhum kākutstha jvalana upamam ॥1-37-27॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakusthas, Karttikeya lustrous like flaming fire, was very fortunate Descended from the womb of the Ganga, he is named Skanda by the gods.
